thread:
molly: Quick heads-up — planning to flip a set of runtime kernel toggles tomorrow 07:00 UTC (canary first). Need fast checks on canary audience, guardrails, and rollback windows.

molly: toggles we want to touch:
- flash-attn -> v2 optimized kernels
- speculative-decoding -> enable for short sequences
- kv-cache -> aggressive trim/limit tweak

molly: proposed canary plan: 10% host routing for 30m, then 50% for 1h if no regressions. Rollback thresholds: error +2% absolute, p99 latency +40ms, tail mem OOMs immediate rollback.

raj: question — for spec-decoding what's the seq_len cutoff? iirc we had issues at 1024. i'd suggest seq_len <= 256 for initial canary.

sarah: also want to confirm scope: hosted-prod only (no dedicated customers) right? Dedicated infra has custom kernels and we shouldn't flip there without ops signoff.

diego: i'll own the rollout script and the feature-flag config. will open a PR in ~30m. ops checks: ensure autoscaler buffer = +15% during canary. PR will contain the actual flag yaml and rollout job config.

molly: yes hosted-prod only. dedicated excluded by default. diego please add a flag gate for "dedicated-exempt" and a rollout playbook.

diego: snippet i'll include in PR (for visibility):
```
feature_flags:
  kernel_flash_attn_v2:
    state: enabled
    sample_pct: 10
  kernel_spec_decoding:
    state: enabled
    sample_pct: 5
    seq_len_max: 256
  kv_cache_trim:
    state: enabled
    sample_pct: 10
    apply_scope: hosted-only
canary:
  duration_minutes: 30
  escalation_metrics:
    error_rate_pct: 2
    p99_latency_ms: 40
```

eva: can we gate speculative-decoding behind the eval harness? i want a quick LMQA run on our core prompt set before we push beyond 5% — last time we saw small degradation on fill-in tasks.

molly: good call. we'll keep spec-decoding at 5% and require eva's green signal on the eval pass. if eval shows >0.5% quality regressions we abort.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if canary crosses rollback thresholds, use `/incident create` and @eng-oncall will be paged. Autotrigger window currently off — recommend keeping it manual for this rollout.

raj: i'll assemble the canary host list and a short litmus test (latency, sample completions, error ratio) — posting by EOD.

diego: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/PR/455 (will add playbook and smoke tests). tagging @sre for autoscaler check.

molly: Action items:
- diego: finish PR + playbook (owner)
- raj: canary host list + smoke tests
- eva: run eval harness and post results by 03:00 UTC
- sarah: confirm dedicated exclusion in infra
- molly: monitor metrics during canary and escalate if needed

molly: if everyone OK, we flip the 07:00 UTC window tomorrow. please react with :thumbsup: when ack'd.

raj: :thumbsup:

diego: :thumbsup:

eva: I'll post eval results here, tentative :thumbsup: after green run.

sarah: ack — will confirm infra gating.

molly: thanks all — i'll schedule the canary and post the final runbook link once diego's PR merges.
